transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Yeah, well, what brings me in is I just keep planning my whole day around not having to drive over those high bridges. It's getting to be a real hassle. And if I can't find a way around it, if I absolutely have to take one, I basically just white-knuckle it the whole way across. I figured it was finally time to talk to someone about it.
Is this fear limited to driving over high bridges, or do you experience similar anxiety in other situations as well?

It's pretty much just the high bridges. I mean, I know those bridges over the bay are built fine, and folks drive them every single day without a problem. But... when I get near one, my mind just acts like the car could go right over the side. So yeah, I don't really get that feeling anywhere else, it's just limited to that.
